supersedes: design_guidelines.v1-espresso-gold.json (espresso/gold, retired in favour of the brand kit)
personality: Modern iOS-inspired glassmorphism on a deep-navy base, dark-first, driven by the Velo brand kit
personality_one_liner: A calm, luminous command center for saving media: deep navy, glass surfaces, a cyan-to-purple brand gradient, and a teal download accent.

source_of_truth.prd: memory/Velo PRD v1.1.md (section 42 UI/UX, 43 Navigation, 47 Themes)
source_of_truth.implementation: frontend/src/design/theme.ts (same keys as color.dark / color.light below; no color literals in components)

gradients.usage: Brand gradient only for the primary CTA, the logomark, progress fill and premium timer. Never as a full-screen background except the splash/hero, where it is a soft radial glow over surface.

logo_only.note: Exact logomark colors from the brand spec. Do not use as UI tokens.

status_colors.note: Maps to PRD section 36 (green / yellow / blue / red). Always pair color with an icon and label (accessibility).

rules: Poppins for screen titles, media titles and numerals in the premium timer.
Inter for body, labels and buttons.
Speed / ETA / size metrics use tabular figures (Inter tnum) or SpaceMono so digits do not jitter while progress updates.
Poppins font files must be added to frontend/assets/fonts (Inter and SpaceMono already exist). Remove Fraunces, Satoshi and SpaceGrotesk when Poppins lands.

spacing.rule: 8pt-based rhythm. Use md (12) inside components and xl (24) between macro sections.

elevation.note: Soft, low-opacity shadows in light theme; in dark theme depth comes from surface tiers and 1px borders, not shadows.

navigation.android_mvp: Custom glass tab bar (expo-blur over 75%+ surface tint).

do: Glass on the bottom tab bar, sticky headers, the Home URL card over the hero glow, and the floating player controls.
Always underlay glass with a surface tint of at least 75% so text stays readable.
Blur intensity is user-adjustable (Settings > Appearance > Glass intensity) and falls back to solid surfaceSecondary on low-end Android.
dont: Never apply glass to list rows, form inputs, or dense queue/download cards.
Never use blur without an underlying tint layer.
Never stack more than one glass layer on top of another.

platform_libraries.native_controls: @expo/ui (BottomSheet, Picker, Slider, Switch, Menu). @gorhom/bottom-sheet only if a required sheet behavior is missing.

components.GlassCard: Blurred container + tint layer + 1px borderStrong at 40% opacity. Only where glassmorphism.do allows.
components.UrlInputBar: Pill input with brandPrimary focus ring, Paste button, Analyze CTA using the brand gradient.
components.MediaTile: expo-image thumbnail with mandatory top-to-bottom scrim (transparent to 80% scrim), title (Poppins), duration pill, status chip.
components.SourceRow: surfaceSecondary row, thumb, title, creator - platform, StatusChip, overflow menu (Download, Redownload, Open Source, Copy URL, Share).
components.DownloadRow: surfaceSecondary card, 0.5pt border, 2-3pt progress bar (brand gradient on surfaceTertiary track), right-aligned Pause/Resume/Cancel, tabular speed/ETA.
components.StatusChip: Icon + label + status color at 16% tint fill.
components.FormatRow: Resolution, label (4K/QHD/Full HD/HD), codec/container, estimated size; selected row uses brandTertiary fill and brandPrimary border.
components.QualityPresetControl: Segmented pill: Best / Balanced / Data Saver / Custom.
components.PremiumTimer: Poppins numerals, teal accent when active, 'Watch Ad +1 Hour' secondary button.
components.EmptyState: Tinted logomark illustration + one line of copy + one CTA.
components.Toast: Glass container allowed (transient), error variant carries a Retry action.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: One link to Detect to Resolve to Choose. Fast, obvious primary action.

states.loading: Brand-gradient ring spinner inside the URL card while analyzing.
states.empty: Logomark illustration with 'Paste a link to get started.'
states.error: Inline glass toast with failure reason and the actions allowed for that failure code.

screens.layout: Top: soft radial brand glow over surface (hero). Glass URL card with pill input, Paste, Analyze. Clipboard-detected chip below. Then Active downloads (max 3, link to Downloads) and Recent sources in a 2-column MediaTile grid.

screens.name: Library
screens.purpose: Everything saved: downloaded media and persistent sources.

states.empty: 'Your library is empty.' + CTA to Home.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header: search + filter button + Grid/List toggle. Segmented [Media] [Sources]. Media = MediaTile grid (All / Videos / Images / Audio / Files chips). Sources = SourceRow list with status chips and 'File missing' badge.

screens.name: Downloads
screens.purpose: Tactical queue: active, waiting, failed, completed.

states.error: Failed cards pinned first with failure-specific actions (Retry, Open Source, Choose another format).

screens.layout: Strict list of DownloadRow. Section headers Active / Waiting / Failed / Completed. No glass on rows.

screens.name: Source Details
screens.purpose: The persistent source: metadata, actions, per-variant download history.

states.error: Source unavailable banner with Open Source / Copy URL.

screens.layout: Hero thumbnail with scrim, title, creator, platform, dates. Primary Download (gradient) + Open Source, Copy URL, Share. Download History list (variant, status, date; 'File Missing' rows show Redownload).

screens.name: Format Picker
screens.purpose: Choose quality/format; remembers the previous choice.

states.empty: No formats: show reason + Open Source
states.error: Resolver failure with Try Another Resolver

screens.layout: Form sheet: preset control, previous-selection banner ('1080p MP4 available' / '1080p unavailable, 720p available'), FormatRow list, Video/Audio toggle, Download button.

screens.name: Tools
screens.layout: List-based. Pill segmented controls for Format (MP3 / M4A / OPUS) and Bitrate; active option uses brandTertiary fill.

screens.name: Player

states.error: Fallback artwork with 'Unable to play media.'

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge artwork/video, heavy bottom scrim, title (Poppins) in the bottom third, floating pill glass control bar in the bottom safe area. System header hidden.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Appearance, downloads, organization, premium, sync, about.
screens.layout: Grouped native-style sections (use @expo/ui where available): Appearance (Light/Dark/System, glass intensity), Downloads (Wi-Fi only, concurrency, default quality), Organization (folder + filename templates), Premium (timer, watch ad), Sync & account, About.

principles: Springs for gestures and sheets, timing for fades
Respect Reduce Motion: replace movement with crossfade
motion.progress_bar: Animated on the UI thread from a shared value fed by throttled (max 4 Hz) native progress events.

accessibility.contrast: Body text at least 4.5:1 on its surface; brandPrimary is used as a fill with onBrandPrimary text, and its tinted text variant is onBrandTertiary on brandTertiary.
accessibility.status: Never rely on color alone: icon + label.

images.splash: Deep navy (#0A1020) with centered logomark + wordmark + tagline 'Save. Convert. Organize.'
images.hero_glow: Generated in-app (radial brand-gradient at 25% opacity over surface); no remote stock photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use only tokens from color.dark / color.light via useTheme. Zero color literals in components.
The retired espresso/gold palette must not appear anywhere.
Poppins for display/titles, Inter for text; tabular figures for live metrics.
Every thumbnail gets the mandatory vertical scrim before overlaying text.
Glass only where glassmorphism.do allows, always over a 75%+ tint, with the low-end fallback.
Sheets, pickers, toggles and sliders: try @expo/ui first.
Every status uses icon + label + color.
Player is edge-to-edge with a floating glass control bar.
